## Problem

What problem are you running into? What are you trying to do that Infra doesn't support today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen? Be as specific as you can, an API shape, a UI sketch, an example config.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered, and why they fall short.

## Where this would live

- [ ] `infra` (auth engine / admin dashboard)
- [ ] `accounts` (the end-user app)
- [ ] `www` (public marketing site)
- [ ] `@infra/assets` (object storage plugin)
- [ ] `@infra/ui` (shared UI kit)
- [ ] A new plugin
- [ ] Not sure

## Additional context

Anything else that helps explain the request, links, prior art in other auth providers, etc.
